locations.title: Young Master Lan
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Speak to [Lan Shaodi](#loc=1060752) and agree to hear his offer.

**Tips:**

- Return to him after unlocking the [Locked Door](#loc=1061822) to Pangzhen
- Find him in Pangzhen to get the [Lan Manor Key](https://mapgenie.io/phantom-blade-zero/maps/pangzhen?locationIds=1061998), then rest at any Bell to continue the quest

**Rewards:**

- [Crimson Resolve](https://mapgenie.io/phantom-blade-zero/maps/pangzhen?locationIds=1062123)

locations.title: The Journey Home
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Speak to [Old Man Gen](#loc=1060747)

**Tips:**

- Return to him after unlocking the [Locked Door](#loc=1061822) to Pangzhen
- Once in Pangzhen, grab the [Dusty Old Wooden Comb](https://mapgenie.io/phantom-blade-zero/maps/pangzhen?locationIds=1063600) and return it to Gen
- This quest ends there, but his story continues in the Meigu Lake region

**Rewards:**

- [War Wagon](https://mapgenie.io/phantom-blade-zero/maps/meigu-lake?locationIds=1064438)

locations.title: A Puppet's Wooden Heart
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Take the letter from the Songstress Puppet. If she's not offering it, come back later.

**Tips:**

- You'll find Pei [here](#loc=1061685)

**Rewards:**

- [A Puppet's Wooden Heart](#loc=1061687)

locations.title: Leave None Alive
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Ask the Wounded Thief if he has any other requests.

**Tips:**

- Head back to the Crimson Woods to retrieve the [Thief's Manual](https://mapgenie.io/phantom-blade-zero/maps/crimson-forest?locationIds=1061610)
- Head back to the Weeping Creek Valley to retrieve the [Prayer Beads](https://mapgenie.io/phantom-blade-zero/maps/weeping-creek-valley?locationIds=1060690)
- Tell [The Stately Monk](#loc=1061663) that you **do not believe** in the Lady, or the quest will fail.

**Rewards:**

- [Arrowward](#loc=1061630)
- [Agarwood Prayer Beads](#loc=1061664)

locations.title: Dahuang
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Speak to the Sleeping Flower-Masked Hunter

**Tips:**

- Progress to Pangzheng and search for the **Pond of Fading Song Bell**
- Along the back wall of a nearby house, you'll find the sleepy [Dahuang](https://mapgenie.io/phantom-blade-zero/maps/pangzhen?locationIds=1062777)

**Rewards:**

- Remnant Dust
